column3: The record-path class defect was fixed and independently approved at the final head.
The regex/counting errors and later table-count error were corrected before final approval.
The checker/Makefile mismatch was corrected before final approval.
The claimed chokepoint and coverage were rewritten and approved at the final head.
The wrong heap extent was fixed, but the same refusal's silent no-enclosing-mapping branch and missing direct detlog_brk_heap coverage remain on current origin/main.
The stale allowlist/Makefile mismatch was corrected and reviewed.
The constant pin and closed-stdin test issue were corrected; the second parsed refusal was a reviewer's approval retraction, not an additional code objection.
The one-string outcome check was widened to the existing non-PASS/non-FAIL outcomes and independently approved.
The missing site coverage was added and approved at the final head.
The no-panic assertion was restored, but E9patch run and record PATH misses still use untyped errors and therefore still map to 125 rather than the PR's claimed 127.
The formatting-only refusal was corrected and approved.
The broad refusal predicate and later final-status objections were fixed and approved at the final head.
The HOME-dependent fixture was replaced by a deterministic absolute fixture and approved.
The checker was scheduled before merge and approved.
Three objections were corrected; the refusal noting that the documented exit table omits shell launch statuses 126 and 127 remains true on current origin/main.
The signal/refusal findings were fixed across later heads and independently approved at the final head.
The shell and Python option-mode findings were fixed and independently approved at the final head.
The redundant assertion and timing-order gap were replaced by an independently observable ordering assertion and approved.
The stale causal claim, missing report assertion, moving timing window, and uninterruptible pause were corrected and approved.
The false GIT_CONFIG cause and non-discriminating control description were corrected and approved.
The per-runner split received both-direction unit coverage and the refusing reviewer approved the final head.

The refusal-marker objections were addressed and the final head received independent approval. A separate unmarked Bash -D objection was still real at merge and was later fixed forward by https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/2674.
The five-selector, empty-result, audit-gaps, JSON, and stale-comment findings were fixed before merge.
The exit-class gate gaps were corrected and independently approved.
The literal checkout path and unscheduled self-test were corrected; repeated exact-head reviews found no remaining issue.
The journal/registry identity error, skill overlap, vocabulary, direct-run, result-path, and final-file-state findings were all corrected before owner-directed landing.
The predicate grammar findings were corrected and independently approved at the final head.

The false 0 ms representation was fixed. The later refusal's four findings remain on current origin/main: publication bypasses the stronger summary checks; DBT and record/replay omit runtime totals; syscall totals lose pre-exec counts; and the fallback trusts log paths parsed from captured stderr.
The final commit adds the missing CellResult-level bracket and corrects the volatile-count claim.
The final commit adds both-direction brackets for the no-comparison guard.
